items.secretDetails: Small silver bottle opener attached to key ring.

items.title: Sony WH-1000XM4 Noise Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones

items.secretDetails: Includes an airline two-prong audio adapter inside mesh pocket.

items.title: Dell 65W USB-C Laptop Charger with Braided Cable

items.secretDetails: Small piece of neon green tape wrapped near the USB-C plug.

items.title: Thomas Calculus & Linear Algebra Textbook (14th Ed)

items.secretDetails: Yellow sticky notes on pages 312 and 455.

items.title: Titan Edge Matte Black Wristwatch
items.description: Ultra-slim black ceramic watch with silver buckle clasp, misplaced near the basketball court spectator bleachers.
items.secretDetails: Slight scratch near the 4 o'clock marker.

items.title: Sai University Student ID Card (CS2026-042)
items.description: Found official campus RFID identity card left on tray return counter after lunch hours.
items.secretDetails: Card barcode ends with digits 8841.

items.title: Apple AirPods Pro (2nd Gen) with MagSafe Case
items.description: Found white AirPods Pro in a dark navy silicone case on the study table near the east window.

items.secretDetails: Initials "AS" faintly engraved on the inside hinge.
